resources.string: Two feeds. One map of what\'s really running.
Navigo combines the operator\'s live feed with crowdsourced rider reports to cover the rest of the network, including microtrans, minibuses, and buses with turned-off trackers.
A GPS dot can\'t tell you if you\'ll fit.
The operator feed knows where the bus is. Riders on board report how full it is, today\'s fare, and route diversions, and Navigo always shows how old those reports are.
Doze off. It wakes you at your stop.
Set a get-off alarm and Navigo rings one stop early, even with your screen locked and your phone in your pocket. It reads both feeds, so it still rings on the lines the operator never tracked.
Every dot says which one it came from
Rings through a minute of dead signal
Works offline on maps you\'ve downloaded
When a line goes quiet, Navigo says so instead of inventing a number, while your ride fills the gap for whoever\'s next.
